passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state to do both of the following: (1) Achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, but no later than 2045, and to achieve and maintain net negative greenhouse gas emissions thereafter.
passages.note: A declared net-zero emissions policy that names carbon removal and carbon capture as paths names no energy source (H17).
passages.actor_quote: AB 1279, Muratsuchi. The California Climate Crisis Act.

rows.reasoning: Muratsuchi authored AB 1279 (2021-2022), which declares a state policy to "Achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, but no later than 2045" and directs the state board to "Identify and implement a variety of policies and strategies that enable carbon dioxide removal solutions and carbon capture, utilization, and storage technologies in California". An emissions target that can be met by carbon capture and removal does not match the object of "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines", and it names neither subsidies nor permitting reform, so it separates the pro-action side only.
needs_source: A record on a clean-energy instrument naming the energy source itself (for example a renewable-procurement standard with dated targets), or his own words on mandates vs. subsidies vs. permitting
